title: Synthetic unsafe deserialization evaluation
why_code_is_vulnerable: The decoder calls pickle.loads on untrusted bytes from the caller. Python's pickle format is executable and can trigger arbitrary code execution when deserializing attacker-controlled payloads, so accepting untrusted data here is unsafe.
expected_vulnerable_test_outcome: The functional test passes because the payload is a harmless synthetic JSON byte string and the mocked pickle loader returns the expected mapping. The security test fails because the vulnerable implementation path still invokes pickle.loads and returns the pickle-mocked value instead of using the mocked JSON parser.
final_repair_success_criteria: The unsafe pickle import and B403 companion finding are removed.
No new high-severity security finding is introduced.
